prioritized_defects.description: The save-trade-information path is not reachable from the successful buy/sell trade path, so successful trade information is not saved as required after a completed trade.
prioritized_defects.evidence: The requirements state that after a successful trade, CTS must give out successful trade information and Security Account Management must save it (R41, R42). In the diagram, the flow from matching/trading goes to N14 and then directly to N19 only via E21, but E21 is guarded by "buy or sell completed" and is preceded by N14 with no clear completion path from the successful buy/sell branch once the trade is done. More importantly, the save-trade branch is disconnected from the actual successful completion logic because the trade-complete path terminates at N22 through N13/N14 paths, leaving the save branch not integrated as the mandatory post-trade step.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Rewire the successful buy/sell flow so that after a completed trade it necessarily transitions to 'Give out trade information' and then to 'Save trade information' before termination.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R3 is not traced to any diagram element.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Requirement R3 states: "System will make a match between them under specifically prescripts." The diagram only includes "Match by stock id" and then a generic matched-stock decision, which captures only part of the stated matching behavior.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add or relabel an action in Central Trading System that explicitly represents matching under prescribed rules, or refine the existing match step so it clearly covers the full requirement.

prioritized_defects.description: The CTS interface behavior for sending messages to other modules is not represented.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Requirement R4 states that the CTS "provides some interfaces to send messages to other modules." The diagram contains only trading workflow steps and no action showing CTS exposing interfaces or sending messages to other modules beyond the query-release path.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add an action in Central Trading System that represents providing/sending messages through interfaces to other modules, or model the required message-sending interaction explicitly.

prioritized_defects.description: The requirement to produce new messages after handling incoming instructions and send them to network message promulgating is not modeled.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Requirement R9 states that CTS receives instructions from trade client serve and then "produce new messages which to be sent to network message promulgating after deal with the instructions." The diagram ends the buy/sell/cancel flows without any action for producing or forwarding messages to network message promulgating.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add a post-processing/message-output step in Central Trading System that sends generated messages to the network message promulgating subsystem.
Connect all diagram nodes to the main workflow.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R14 is not traced to any diagram element.
prioritized_defects.evidence: When the system crashes down, they can find the cause and fix it.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add or connect a diagram element representing this requirement.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R15 is not traced to any diagram element.
prioritized_defects.evidence: When new requirements should be supported, they can modify the program to make it fit.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add or connect a diagram element representing this requirement.

prioritized_defects.description: The maintainers' crash-analysis and fix behavior is not represented.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Requirement R14 says that when the system crashes, maintainers can find the cause and fix it. The diagram has no exception or maintenance path for crash recovery or fault diagnosis.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add an exception or maintenance branch for system crash handling that includes cause analysis and fixing by maintainers.

prioritized_defects.description: The maintainers' ability to modify the program to support new requirements is not modeled.
prioritized_defects.evidence: Requirement R15 states that when new requirements should be supported, maintainers can modify the program to make it fit. No diagram element covers this maintenance capability.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add a maintenance-oriented action or separate diagram fragment showing program modification for new requirements.

final_recommendation: Prioritize the blocking control-flow defect first, then the high-severity coverage and structural issues that affect core behavior, and leave the medium-severity maintenance-related coverage gaps for the next pass.
